test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

He is **enough rich** to buy a car.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**enough rich**" is grammatically incorrect because the word "**enough**" should follow the adjective "**rich**."
 
• In English, the correct structure is "**adjective + enough**" to indicate sufficiency.
 
• Therefore, "**rich enough**" is the grammatically correct phrase.
 
• Options like "**rich too much**" or "**too rich**" convey a different meaning and do not fit the intended context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is rich enough to buy a car."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "rich too much"** – This phrase is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 2: "sufficiently rich"** – While this phrase is grammatically correct, it alters the intended tone of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "too rich"** – This conveys excess rather than sufficiency, which does not fit the context.
